The Ti-5Nb alloy with α + β phases exhibited a hardness value of 358 VHN, higher than that of cp-Ti due to the solid solution strengthening by Nb addition.
Nb addition to the Ti alloy acted as a β stabilizer, thus lowering the β-transus temperature.
This increase in hardness could be attributed to the increase in the β phase and the strengthening effect of the ω phase [16].
